criteria.connection_begin: Report connection_failed with phase begin when the native begin is refused or finds a closed pool. The driver failure reads as a connection problem, connection problems belong to the pool boundary, and transaction_failed then means only trouble within a live transaction.
criteria.review_needed: On this evidence neither placement wins, or both break a required contract.
criteria.transaction_begin: Report transaction_failed with phase begin when the native begin is refused or finds a closed pool. Entry is the operation that failed, the pool connection was already proven by open, and one entry error keeps handling uniform.

begin_failure_error.instructions: Decide which catalogue error a refused or closed native begin on an already-open pool should surface. Consult common with topics.begin_failure_error.

criteria.opaque_random: Mint an independent random token for each attempt. Diagnostics reveal no pool identity, sequence position, or attempt total, and collisions are for practical purposes impossible.
criteria.review_needed: On this evidence neither ID shape wins, or both break a required contract.
criteria.structured_sequence: Compose the ID from the pool resource identity and a monotonic per-pool attempt number. Log readers trace each attempt to its pool, tests pin exact values, and still no driver payload appears.

commit_unknown_id.instructions: Decide what the commit_unknown transaction_id should contain. Consult common with topics.commit_unknown_id.

criteria.bounded_drain: Cap the drain with a fixed deadline; owners still unsettled at expiry yield transaction_failed with phase drain and no commit happens. Worst-case commit latency is bounded no matter how a sublease behaves.
criteria.review_needed: On this evidence neither drain policy wins, or both break a required contract.
criteria.unbounded_drain: Let the drain run until every existing sublease finishes, holding the native callback pending all the while. Running work is never cut off by a timer, which is how owner scopes already drain.

drain_bound.instructions: Decide if the drain ahead of commit may wait without limit or must expire. Consult common with topics.drain_bound.

fixed_constraints: sql::with_transaction<T> in the catalogue emits connection_failed, transaction_failed and commit_unknown: a phase string on the first pair, a transaction_id string on the last. The callback input is sql::transaction, the callback result is sql::decision<T>, the callback emits nothing, and the variant offers exactly commit<T> versus rollback<T>, both records wrapping a value.

Observed on Bun 1.4.2: a begin whose callback returns normally resolves with that same return value, while a callback throw rejects begin with the very object thrown, preserving sentinel identity across the boundary. Refusal surfaces as PostgresError ERR_POSTGRES_CONNECTION_REFUSED and post-close begin as PostgresError ERR_POSTGRES_CONNECTION_CLOSED. Calling begin on the tx handle itself is rejected natively and points at savepoints; any statement following a failed one in the transaction fails with 25P02. The tx handle accepts the identical tagged-template invocation shape as the pool client.

One transaction scope may be active at a time under the owner contract: re-entering with_transaction or touching an escaped or stale handle throws via invalid() as a standard resource_state failure. The rollback path throws a private sentinel that is recognized outside begin, commit is returned only once the scope has drained, a kept primary standard failure beats later cleanup failures, and any native rejection past a commit decision becomes commit_unknown with no automatic retry.

The transaction query family reuses I35 value encoding, row decoding and failure classification: PostgresError alone classifies, anything else thrown travels the generic fault path, and diagnostics admit sanitized fields only, excluding message, detail, URL and credentials.
common.purpose: Judge the Can transaction questions only on the material given in this request. No browsing, no implementation, no prose explanation. Where the material leaves candidates tied, take the designated uncertainty option.

begin_failure_error.facts: Both candidate errors are already emitted by with_transaction and both take a phase string. The measured native failures look like connection failures by code, but they strike during transaction entry on a pool that opened cleanly. Either error can carry the begin phase.

commit_unknown_id.facts: The single transaction_id string on commit_unknown must be diagnostics-safe, hence free of driver payloads and credentials. Available ingredients are the pool resource identity with a local attempt count, or else fresh randomness per attempt. The fault-proxy check demands presence and safety, not a particular shape.

drain_bound.facts: Once the callback outcome exists, the scope flips to closing, owners drain, the native callback remains pending, and commit is withheld until draining ends. Subleases already running get to complete. A supervisor-driven check must still witness nonsettling owners, so whichever policy is chosen has to keep that case visible.
